abstract: The accuracy of CT scanning prior to para-aortic lymphadenectomy was assessed in 108 patients with metastatic testicular teratoma. In 106 its presence was confirmed by surgery. The site was accurately predicted in 95%. A good correlation (P less than 0.0025) was found between mean tumour cross-sectional area assessed by CT scanning and that measured in the excised pathological specimens.
abstract_ja: 大きな転移を有する精巣奇形腫患者108例において、傍大動脈リンパ節郭清術前のコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)検査の正確性を評価した。106例では手術によりその存在が確認された。部位は95%で正確に予測された。CTで評価した腫瘍の平均断面積は、切除標本の計測値との間に良好な相関を認めた(P<0.0025)。
